title: HR Officer
company: Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Council - Agency - Permanent
advertiser_name: Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Council
description:
Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Councils are looking for a HR Officer to join our team on a part-time, permanent contract based in Ipswich, Suffolk. The successful candidate will earn a competitive salary of £32,578 - £37,563 per annum (pro rata).

This role is open to part-time and job-share applications, all of which will be assessed equally.

Join our team

Are you organised, accurate and passionate about providing a great employee experience?

We are looking for an enthusiastic HR Officer to join our HR and OD (Human Resources and Organisational Development) team.

This is a varied role in which you will help ensure that our payroll, employee benefits and employment documentation are managed accurately, efficiently and on time.

You will be part of a supportive team and have the opportunity to build your HR knowledge while working across a wide range of activities that make a real difference to our employees.

If you share our values and are motivated to make a difference for our residents, clients, and communities, we would love to hear from you.

About the role

Reporting to the People Partner Operations, you will provide reliable and professional support across our operational HR service.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop broad experience across payroll, employee benefits and the employee lifecycle while contributing ideas that improve the service we provide.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing employee and payroll changes accurately through Oracle.
- Working with our payroll provider to help deliver an accurate and timely monthly payroll.
- Completing payroll checks, reconciliations and year-end activities.
- Administering employee benefits, including pensions, salary sacrifice arrangements, car schemes and additional voluntary contributions.
- Preparing contracts of employment and other employee correspondence.
- Responding to payroll, benefits and general HR enquiries from employees and managers.
- Maintaining accurate records, procedures, checklists and guidance.
- Identifying discrepancies and resolving routine issues or escalating them when appropriate.
- Supporting pay awards, salary increments, audit requirements and councillor payroll activities.
- Providing recruitment administration support during busy periods or colleague absence.

About you

Ideally, you will be educated to A-level standard or equivalent and hold a CIPD Level 3 qualification or have equivalent relevant experience.

You will be approachable, dependable and comfortable working with detailed and confidential information. You will enjoy helping people, solving problems and making sure important processes run smoothly.

What you will bring to the role
- Experience of providing administrative support within HR, payroll or a similar service environment.
- An understanding of HR processes, payroll, employee benefits and the employee lifecycle.
- Experience of preparing contracts, correspondence or other formal documentation.
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to meet recurring deadlines.
- Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence in responding to employee and manager enquiries.
- The ability to maintain confidentiality and handle personal information appropriately.
- Competence in Microsoft Word and Excel, with the confidence to learn and use HR systems.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively as part of a team.

About us

At Babergh and Mid Suffolk District Councils we are passionate about building communities that people want to live, work, visit and invest in.

We serve around 200,000 residents across our two districts and are well known for our collaboration and partnership working across public, private and voluntary sectors.

We believe that the heart of Suffolk is an incredibly special place to live and work, with:
- 60 conservation areas
- two National Landscapes
- many picturesque market towns

It is no surprise we are ranked among the top 50 places to live in the UK (United Kingdom).

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:
- Generous leave entitlement (26 days a year, rising to 31 days after 5 years).
- Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme.
- Wellbeing Support and Employee Assistance Programs.
- Private Health Care Options.
- Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
- Paid volunteering days.
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements (Business needs permitting).
- Great learning and development opportunities.

Our ways of working

We believe work is what we do, not just where we go.

We work in a hybrid way, with a mix of office, home, and remote based working (Business need permitting). Our hybrid working arrangements support flexibility and collaboration, helping our teams to thrive.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, providing opportunity and ambition for all, supporting and enabling our people to deliver the best possible services for our residents.

Closing date: 5.00 pm, 30 November 2026
